falsifier: the old property value is not disposed (leaked) when overwritten
alternative: the inner D object is never freed: heap live o 1 instead of 0
note: 0x10 row: 'old prop disposed'. o.a first holds a D object (refcount 1), then the int 1 replaces it, which frees D. allocs o = 2 (C and D), live 0 after Return. helpers: CreateStackVariables (0x23), CreateObject (0x13), SetVariableValue (0x22), GetVariableValue (0x21), GetMemberValue (0x11).
